tasks.title: Deliver bounded unpublished Configuration candidate preview
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver an additive optional side-effect-free candidate-preview companion required by the approved pre-publication R07 review. The closed command identifies one actual application/configuration/schema, selected bound enabled source, strong source and assignment-map preconditions, explicit Common/Application baseline publication references or deliberate absence, and exact bounded draft JSON. Resolve and authorize actual resources under the qualified clean readonly transaction; reuse existing immutable-reference integrity, single defaults/Common/Application composition, structural validation, bounded change paths/recipients and native redaction rules. Check both preconditions in that snapshot and bind continuation to exact command/draft digest/preconditions and current actor scope. Return candidate-specific identity/references/preconditions and server-computed draft SHA256; never manufacture a publication ID or label baseline refs as published candidate content. Keep hidden defaults/other content redacted; no empty-value fallback or authority inferred from hints. Preview creates no publication/release/assignment/quota/operation/Audit effect and implies no local semantic adoption. Preserve existing Preview and compulsory interfaces; missing optional backend is unsupported after authorization. No new schema/package, Scheduler runtime, merge/validation framework or source-CIS changes.

Include focused unit/native/browser-client tests, canonical contract cases, scoped formatting, documentation and independent security review. Preserve original176 evidence and full177 editor requirements in sibling; same100 parent allocation/globalcaps and all-agent accounting, no extra capacity.
